sources.title: UAE Government portal: End of service benefits for workers in the private sector

rules.summary: General UAE private-sector gratuity estimate for eligible full-time foreign workers using basic wage.
formula: totalServiceDays = calendar days from joiningDate through lastWorkingDate
serviceYearUnits = complete calendar-anniversary years plus remaining eligible days prorated by the current anniversary-year length
if eligibleServiceDays is less than the first calendar-anniversary year then gratuity = 0
assumptions: Basic wage is used, not total compensation.
Resignation and ordinary employer termination use the same base gratuity formula in this estimate.
Unpaid absence days are subtracted from eligible service days and cannot exceed total service days.
The total gratuity estimate is capped at 24 months of basic wage.
Unsupported employment contexts and alternative savings schemes return REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of an AED estimate.

rules.summary: Notice period calculation rules need official-source validation before launch.
General UAE private-sector notice estimate for standard post-probation and supported probation scenarios.
assumptions: Post-probation notice is constrained to 30-90 days.
Payment in lieu is estimated from monthly basic salary divided by 30 and unserved notice days.
Unsupported employment contexts and special regimes return REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.summary: Leave salary calculation rules need official-source validation before launch.
General UAE private-sector leave salary estimate for annual leave pay or unused leave final settlement.
assumptions: Unused annual leave is estimated from accrued annual leave days less used leave days.
Final-settlement leave salary uses the supported leave salary engine and flags unsupported contexts.
Special free-zone, non-standard, and unsupported cases return REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.summary: General UAE private-sector final settlement composition using gratuity, leave salary, notice compensation, unpaid salary, additions, and documented deductions.
assumptions: The calculator composes reviewed gratuity, leave salary, and notice engines.
Manual deductions require documented legal authority or payroll recovery reason.
Unsupported contexts and component-level review flags bubble up as REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.summary: General UAE private-sector resignation estimate for notice recovery, gratuity, leave salary, and final settlement components.
assumptions: Resignation uses the approved final settlement engine with employee-resignation notice direction.
Employer recovery is surfaced separately and requires documented agreement or dispute process.
Special regimes, probation edge cases, and unsupported contexts return REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.summary: General UAE private-sector ordinary employer termination estimate for gratuity, leave salary, notice pay, unpaid salary, additions, and documented deductions.
assumptions: Ordinary employer termination uses the approved final settlement engine with termination notice direction.
Employer short notice is shown as notice pay in lieu unless a lawful exception applies.
Article 44/misconduct, DIFC/ADGM, special free-zone, probation, undocumented deduction, and non-standard cases return REVIEW_REQUIRED.
